prompt.text: Use code 1 for a table, 2 for a bar graph, 3 for a pictogram, 4 for a line graph and 5 for a pie chart. A health report contains 18 age groups with exact counts and percentages; accurate lookup matters more than visual impact. For the reason code, use 1 if a bar graph cannot show age groups, 2 if a bar graph would make readers estimate the exact values from bar heights, or 3 if a bar graph can show only percentages. Enter a two-digit number: the first digit is the code of the most suitable display and the second digit is the reason code.

content.text: Decide what readers must do with the numbers: see a picture of them or find each exact figure.

There are 18 groups, each with exact counts and percentages, and readers must look up exact figures. Choose the display that shows every figure with nothing to estimate, then think about what a bar graph would force readers to do.
A table shows every count and percentage exactly. A bar graph would make readers estimate the exact values from the bar heights, so the reason code is 2.
